name: Luiss Guido Carli
summary: Private university in Rome for business, economics, law and politics; five English bachelor's, with a direct offer for IB students on 36 points.

ib.text: IB Diploma or predicted grades of 36/45 or more give direct admission (EU/Schengen route). Below that, sit the online Luiss Test (SAT-style: logic, problem-solving, maths).

dates.label: Luiss Test, first session: applications close
Luiss Test, first session: online test window opens (22–26 February)
Direct admission with IB 36/45, SAT or ACT: applications close

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: Business economics with management, finance, law, quantitative methods and IT, taught in English with an international, multidisciplinary outlook.
programmes.selectionNote: Direct offer with IB 36/45 (predicted counts), SAT 1200 or ACT 25; otherwise you sit the online Luiss Test in English.

programmes.name: Economics and Business
programmes.about: Economics, management, finance, law and quantitative methods, with particular attention to European institutions, market regulation, competition and antitrust.
programmes.selectionNote: Direct offer with IB 36/45 (predicted counts), SAT 1200 or ACT 25; otherwise you sit the online Luiss Test in English.

programmes.name: Global Law
programmes.about: Law for cross-border careers in multinationals, NGOs and European and international organisations, with economics, management and tech, focused on global governance and human rights.
programmes.selectionNote: Direct offer with IB 36/45 (predicted counts), SAT 1200 or ACT 25; otherwise you sit the online Luiss Test in English.

programmes.name: Management and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: Management and economics combined with quantitative and IT skills, to apply AI, big data and machine learning to business decisions and strategy.
programmes.selectionNote: Direct offer with IB 36/45 (predicted counts), SAT 1200 or ACT 25; otherwise you sit the online Luiss Test in English.

programmes.name: Politics: Philosophy and Economics
programmes.about: Philosophy, politics and economics with law, history, sociology and quantitative methods; a third-year track in AI, sustainability or fundamental rights.
programmes.selectionNote: Direct offer with IB 36/45 (predicted counts), SAT 1200 or ACT 25; otherwise you sit the online Luiss Test in English.

notes: The full 2027-28 admission notice comes out from October 2026, when applications open; each route costs €150 to enter.
The degree you choose when you apply is binding for admission and enrolment.
Luiss also runs a second Luiss Test session for EU students; its dates were not yet published.
